title: Management Information Systems: Main Exam, 20 April 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO IN SECTION B

parts.text: Explain the key characteristics of decision support systems.
Explain the term connectivity as a component of a computer system and examine its benefits.

In reference to the viewpoint that employees are the greatest concern in information systems security, explain the methods and technologies that can be applied to protect firms against such security threats.
Analyse the key characteristics of transaction processing systems.
Examine the key components of information technology (IT) infrastructure.
Evaluate the challenges that a firm may experience in the management of IT infrastructure.

items.text: In reference to the perspective that "cyber security is not a concern of the IT department; it is a board issue":

parts.text: Examine to what extent and how this perspective would be deemed relevant and efficient.
Evaluate the ethical and social aspects facing organizations as they seek to curb cyber-crime and enhance organizational productivity.
Explain the 4 basic functional areas in a business organization that can leverage information systems, and indicate the relevant business processes.
Evaluate the manifestation and implications of intellectual property rights as a critical ethical issue in the context of modern technologies.
Examine the main activities in information systems strategic planning.
Explain the adoption and implementation of information systems from the perspective of organizational change.
